#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    vector<int> beauty(n);
    int totalBeauty = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> beauty[i];
        totalBeauty += beauty[i];
    }

    vector<int> equalPairs;
    vector<int> charOccurrencesInEqualPairs(128, 0);
    char mostCommonCharInEqualPairs = 'a';

    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
        if (s[i] == s[n - 1 - i]) {
            equalPairs.push_back(i);
            if (++charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[s[i]] > charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[mostCommonCharInEqualPairs]) {
                mostCommonCharInEqualPairs = s[i];
            }
        }
    }

    int ans = totalBeauty;
    for (int equalPair : equalPairs) {
        ans -= min(beauty[equalPair], beauty[n - 1 - equalPair]);
    }

    if (charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[mostCommonCharInEqualPairs] > (int(equalPairs.size()) / 2)) {
        vector<int> nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties;
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
            if (s[i] != s[n - 1 - i] && s[i] != mostCommonCharInEqualPairs && s[n - 1 - i] != mostCommonCharInEqualPairs) {
                nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties.push_back(min(beauty[i], beauty[n - 1 - i]));
            }
        }
        sort(nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties.begin(), nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties.end());
        int rem = 2 * charOccurrencesInEqualPairs[mostCommonCharInEqualPairs] - (int(equalPairs.size()));
        for (int i = 0; i < rem; ++i) {
            ans -= nonEqualPairsMinBeautyPenalties[i];
        }
    }

    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
